stories.title: Father charged after student accidentally brings gun to Union County elementary school
stories.summary: Investigators determined the student accidentally took her father's book bag to school. The bag contained a firearm.

stories.title: Norovirus confirmed as cause of illness outbreak at Richmond County elementary school
stories.summary: The investigation also found that some family members developed similar symptoms after students and staff became sick.

stories.title: Weather Alert: Widespread rain, gusty winds to impact Thanksgiving in the Carolinas
stories.summary: It's going to be a cold, windy and wet Thanksgiving across the Charlotte area, with weather impacting travel and holiday events.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travel in Charlotte faces rain and wind, clearing by Black Friday
stories.summary: A developing coastal storm is set to bring rain and travel delays to the Piedmont during busy Thanksgiving travel days, clearing just in time for Black Friday sun.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travel expected to bring millions onto roads and through airports
stories.summary: Officials say drivers should anticipate delays, especially if weather conditions worsen.

stories.title: CMPD releases bodycam footage of former officer shoving teen off a bicycle
stories.summary: Malcolm Joseph, 34, resigned from CMPD in July days after the Uptown Charlotte incident.

stories.title: Charlotte City Council approves new e-bike rules, including potential criminal penalties
stories.summary: Riders now must yield to pedestrians on sidewalks and many teenagers will have to wear helmets.

stories.title: Thanksgiving giveaway helps feed families from Beatties Ford to Nations Ford
stories.summary: Alternative to Violence's Ford to Ford event offered Thanksgiving meals, clothing, and essentials across 15 miles in Charlotte, uniting and supporting the community.

stories.title: Flu hospitalizations surge in South Carolina now visitor limits at area hospitals
stories.summary: SC health data shows 749 people hospitalized with the flu this season, a major increase from this time last year.

stories.title: Woman says she was ripped out of home, arrested after flashing headlights to warn drivers about police
stories.summary: Brown says the encounter escalated when an officer approached her at her Lowell home and now she's questioning whether the officer's actions were justified.

stories.title: Teen missing from east Charlotte found safe
stories.summary: The teen was located unharmed, CMPD said Wednesday.

stories.title: Charge dismissed for Rep.-elect LaKesha Womack in rental car case, Mecklenburg DA says
stories.summary: Mecklenburg County District Attorney Spencer Merriweather said the matter was resolved between Rep.-elect Womack and the rental company.
